0028:     def agent(self):

0030:         agent.publish_json = lambda relative, value, message: atomic_json(self.control / relative, value)
0031:         agent.acquire_remote_claim = lambda request: atomic_json(self.control / agent.claim_relative(request["request_id"]), {"request_fingerprint": request_fingerprint(request)}) or True

0037:             return {"request_fingerprint": request_fingerprint(request), "result": {"returncode": 0}}
